title: Add JSON output for receipt batches
summary: Add stable machine-readable output for `covenant chain receipt-batches --json` so automation can inspect flushed local receipt roots without parsing human text.
expectedFailureModes: Receipt batch automation depends on human output that can change without schema review.
The chain.batches gate has daemon coverage but no stable CLI contract.
Live coverage can create receipt batches but cannot assert their machine-readable shape.
nextAction: Define the receipt batch JSON shape, add CLI rendering tests, and cover it with a live CLI round trip.
